plugins.name: ctx
plugins.description: Context window details like the Desktop app's panel: /ctx opens a pane that docks beside the transcript, and a 📊 button above the prompt toggles it

plugins.name: subagent-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel for any subagent work, each subagent a crab whose costume follows its model and effort. Fork of johnnyvizz's savvy-progress.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a great one before it is sent: /better asks up to three quick questions, rewrites the prompt and shows original and upgrade side by side. Nothing runs until you press Run. Idea and spec from https://tristenobrien.ai/.

plugins.name: work-report
plugins.description: Shows what Claude has done for you: /report opens a pane with Today, Week, Month and Year tabs of tasks finished, an estimate of the hours that saved you and what that time is worth.

plugins.name: agent-pulse
plugins.description: A box above the prompt that says what Claude is doing right now, alive with color and motion: a spinner per phase, flashes and a breathing border, a timeline of the turn, and a jellyfish on the desktop. Fork of Tzafrir Rehan's whats-agent-doing.

plugins.name: arsenal
plugins.description: A menu for the tool mods in this repo and for your own commands: a button in the footer under the prompt box opens a menu pane, docked on the right, with a Prompt Upgrade switch, one-press shortcuts to /better and /report, and USER and PROJECT sections listing your own skills and commands, each of which you can turn off. A remote control, so every row runs a command that already exists. Idea from https://tristenobrien.ai/.

plugins.name: waypoints
plugins.description: A route for /goal and any multi-step work, built from Claude's own task plan: the plan as nodes and legs above the prompt, an ETA, a pane that opens by itself with the whole task trail, and every chat's goal in /waypoints. Follows Agent-Pulse's palette and animation. The mod itself asks Claude to plan, so no line in the global CLAUDE.md. Fork of Nate Herk's goal-meter.
